'''Jyd Renyr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living and working on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. The arena manager at the underground fighting pits of the [[Loaded Savrip]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]], he lived in [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A portly man, Renyr was primarily concerned with his profits and held little regard for the lives of the fighters.<ref name="MPQ" />
